# m.economy.treasury_yields

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

US Treasury yields at constant maturities from one month to 30 years, one row per day.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.economy.treasury_yields(*, start=None, end=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

- [Methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `Date`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows its rule under [shared arguments](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`start`](README.md#start) | The first date. |
| [`end`](README.md#end) | The last date. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | Any of Massive's field names, such as `"yield_10_year"`. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Further endpoint parameters. Keys: none. |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Date` | String | Calendar date of the yield observation (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `Yield10Year` | double | Market Yield on U.S. Treasury Securities at 10-Year Constant Maturity, Quoted on an Investment Basis |
| `Yield1Month` | double | Market Yield on U.S. Treasury Securities at 1-Month Constant Maturity, Quoted on an Investment Basis |
| `Yield1Year` | double | Market Yield on U.S. Treasury Securities at 1-Year Constant Maturity, Quoted on an Investment Basis |
| `Yield20Year` | double | Market Yield on U.S. Treasury Securities at 20-Year Constant Maturity, Quoted on an Investment Basis |
| `Yield2Year` | double | Market Yield on U.S. Treasury Securities at 2-Year Constant Maturity, Quoted on an Investment Basis |
| `Yield30Year` | double | Market Yield on U.S. Treasury Securities at 30-Year Constant Maturity, Quoted on an Investment Basis |
| `Yield3Month` | double | Market Yield on U.S. Treasury Securities at 3-Month Constant Maturity, Quoted on an Investment Basis |
| `Yield3Year` | double | Market Yield on U.S. Treasury Securities at 3-Year Constant Maturity, Quoted on an Investment Basis |
| `Yield5Year` | double | Market Yield on U.S. Treasury Securities at 5-Year Constant Maturity, Quoted on an Investment Basis |
| `Yield6Month` | double | Market Yield on U.S. Treasury Securities at 6-Month Constant Maturity, Quoted on an Investment Basis |
| `Yield7Year` | double | Market Yield on U.S. Treasury Securities at 7-Year Constant Maturity, Quoted on an Investment Basis |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. In a `poll()` table, it's the time of the poll the row's values came from. |
